theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

top_news.title: Stocks Rise as Inflation Data Outweighs Chip Rout: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Another report showing softer-than-anticipated inflation drove stocks and bonds higher as Wall Street traders further dialed back wagers on Federal Reserve interest-rate increases.

top_news.title: JPMorgan Leads $3 Billion Financing for Warburg’s Pantherx Buy
top_news.summary: A group of lenders led by JPMorgan Chase & Co. is lining up a debt package worth up to $3 billion to support Warburg Pincus’ acquisition of Pantherx Specialty LLC, according to people familiar with the matter.

top_news.title: Emerging Currencies Gain as Traders Cut Back Fed Bets on US PPI
top_news.summary: An index tracking emerging-market currencies rose Wednesday as the dollar weakened after softer-than-expected US producer prices drove traders to scale back wagers on Federal Reserve interest-rate increases this year.

top_news.title: Education Firm Anima Sinks Over 30% as Analysts Pan M&A Deal
top_news.summary: Shares of Brazilian education company Anima Holding SA slumped a record 33% on Wednesday after it agreed to repurchase a business it had sold five years ago, with analysts citing high valuation and an increase in leverage.

top_news.title: Kalshi Seeks to Let Traders Bet on Flight Cancellation Rates
top_news.summary: Your flight? Canceled. The silver lining? You might be able to make some money off the misery.

top_news.title: SpaceX Shares Briefly Slip Below IPO Price for First Time
top_news.summary: SpaceX shares slumped to their lowest level since the rocket, satellite, and artificial intelligence company went public, briefly falling below their initial public offering price, as investor fanfare quickly evaporated in the month since its trading debut.

top_news.title: Brazil to Offer Billions in Debt Relief for Struggling Farmers
top_news.summary: Brazil’s government plans to publish a provisional measure on Wednesday to renegotiate more than 100 billion reais ($20 billion) in rural debt, as President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva prepares to seek reelection in October.

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for July 15
top_news.summary: Oil narrowly held onto a three-day winning streak as the US launched fresh strikes on Iran in response to a spate of attacks on shipping vessels and American diesel stockpiles posted a sizeable increase.

top_news.title: SpaceX IPO Lifts Wall Street ECM Revenue to Best Since 2021
top_news.summary: Wall Street’s biggest investment banks hauled in the most revenue from advising on equity offerings in the second quarter since 2021, fueled by SpaceX’s record-setting IPO and a fundraising blitz for artificial intelligence infrastructure.

top_news.title: Short-Sellers Swarm SpaceX With Paper Profit Nearing $4 Billion
top_news.summary: SpaceX bears are minting billions on paper as the company’s stock price cracks ahead of a closely-watched rocket launch and upcoming earnings that will unlock a flood of shares.
